See you soon!
Exkee Team

notes.title: The new multiplayer mode of KTBG is available now!
notes.notes:
Sometimes it’s good to be bad! We are proud to announce today that our gory puzzler, Kill The Bad Guy has received a [b]new multiplayer gameplay mode entitled Gangs of Bad Guys[/b]. Gangs of Bad Guys offers players an unseen multiplayer experience and is a FREE extension of the original game.

In Gangs of Bad Guys, players will take control of their own very own Bad Guy, choosing from 16 different character skins. Play online with [b]up to 16 other players[/b] (or A.I.) in free-for-all or in team-based matches, fight it out across [b]12 different maps[/b], and select from [b]4 different gameplay modes[/b].

Players can choose to be a lone wolf or a team leader and strategist – use hackable items, collect in-game money to purchase new weaponry, take advantage of each level’s unique design, and execute actions with skill and speed. Make master strokes to take down opposing Bad Guys.

Watch the [b]new trailer[/b] of Gangs of Bad Guys:

https://youtu.be/nAFXr16n8oY

[img]http://www.ktbg-thegame.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/SplashScreen-Multi-1920-A.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Introducing the A.I. in KTBG's multiplayer mode (beta)
notes.notes:
Last and biggest update in the multiplayer mode of KTBG before its release: you can now add [b]bots[/b] and play against or with them!

That's the last important thing that was missing: characters controlled by an A.I., in order to play with more characters, and thus to always have funny and bloody game sessions. The server (host player) can add [b]up to 16 bots[/b], and you can play with them in your team, or against them. Thus, you can even play alone to the multiplayer mode, which is a good way to learn how to play.

[b]Three levels of difficulty[/b] are available for the A.I., and you can play with them in the four different game modes: ‘Serial Killers’, ‘Gang Supremacy’, ‘Capture the flags’, and ‘Godfather’. There’s also an intelligent ‘auto-completion’ feature that adds many bots at the same time for the big maps that are best for 8 or 10 players. 

Try it! Enjoy it! And don’t hesitate to send us your feedbacks.

Exkee Team

notes.title: Demo, Steam Trading Cards, and first Reviews!
notes.notes:
[*] A free playable [b]demo[/b] of KTBG is now available. Discover 10 levels + 1 bonus in this demo. The full game has 66+ levels and tons of funny things to unlock.

[*] We added the [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b], emoticons and profile backgrounds, and we also corrected minor bugs.

[*] Despite the E3 where everyone is talking about AAA, KTBG got its [b]first reviews[/b]. More to come we hope!

[EN]
[b]Gamespot[/b] – 7/10
http://www.gamespot.com/reviews/kill-the-bad-guy-review/1900-6415785/
“This is a game about killing, but it's a fun, lightweight game about killing that mostly succeeds by blending cunning logic- and physics-based puzzles with a great sense of humor.”

[b]ChristCenteredGamer[/b] – 80%
http://www.christcenteredgamer.com/index.php/reviews/18-computer/5703-kill-the-bad-guy-pc
“While it’s not right to seek vengeance (Romans 12:19), as a parent, I don’t mind letting a tree fall over and kill this guy.”

[FR]
[b]Gameblog.fr[/b] – 7/10
http://www.gameblog.fr/tests/1961-kill-the-bad-guy-pc-mac
« Si vous voulez un puzzle game joli (épuré, mais joli), sanglant, marrant et conséquent (les niveaux bonus sont vraiment chouettes), Kill the Bad Guy est un bon achat. »

[b]Indiemag.fr[/b] – Bien fun !
http://www.indiemag.fr/tests/kill-bad-guy-massacrezles-tous
« L'humour du studio Exkee et les choix artistiques qui ont été fait confèrent au jeu une identité forte, ce qui joue clairement en sa faveur. »

[GER] 
[b]Games-Mag.de[/b] – 71%
http://games-mag.de/spiele/kill-bad-guy-bei-uns-im-test/
“Jegliche Moralvorstellungen werden hier mit Füßen getreten – welch eine Freude.“ 
“Dieses Rätselspiel ist ein Genuss”

[RU] 
[b]Igrogon/Root Nation[/b] – 10 out of 10
http://igrogon.com/03/06/2014/kill-the-bad-guy-desyat-iz-desyati/
«Kill The Bad Guy» это очень веселая и интересная головоломка с необычной механикой, в которой можно провести не один десяток часов. 
Замечательная игра для тех, кто устал от современных «ААА»-блокбастеров и хочет просто сесть, расслабится и поиграть во что-нибудь веселое и необычное."
